environments.rationale: shared CI is suitable for bounded smoke budgets but too noisy to claim tight relative performance superiority

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process projection of one prevalidated tenant/environment context envelope, measured by a standard-library-only runtime probe that excludes build and process-startup time from the reported per-operation latency.
targets.rationale: The runtime now exists and is verified, so the coarse shared-CI absolute p95 ceiling can execute on PRs that touch the pilot runtime while retaining on-demand execution. Shared CI still makes no relative-performance claim.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process validation of one tenant/time/source/permission/provenance Event Search envelope. The standard-library-only runtime is executable; build and process-startup time are excluded from the reported per-operation latency.
targets.rationale: The bounded Event Search validation runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to deterministic in-process envelope validation, not backend search latency and not a production Search SLO.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process Search Job orchestration from queued through running to completed against a no-op backend that only acknowledges validated sources. Job creation, build/process startup and backend work are excluded from the reported per-operation latency.
targets.rationale: The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to backend-neutral Search Job orchestration overhead. It is separate from Event Search validation latency, excludes backend execution, and is not a production search SLO.

targets.workload_description: First-party Event Search frontend local deep-link normalization and bounded incremental result-render update overhead measured by the real ES-module runtime under Node 24.21.0. The probe excludes Node process startup, backend search execution, network transport and browser paint/layout.
targets.rationale: A 16 ms coarse upper bound reserves one 60 Hz frame for local Event Search state/render overhead. The implemented first-party runtime can now execute this deterministic PR/on-demand probe. The measurement excludes backend/network/browser paint and is not a production Search SLO.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process construction of one permission-gated immutable Event inspection projection from already-resolved source, parser, field and enrichment inputs. Retrieval, parser execution, entity resolution, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: The bounded Event Inspection projection runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to deterministic local projection overhead; retrieval, parsing, provider work and production SLOs remain outside this target.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process creation of one dialect-neutral PivotDraft from an already-authorized inspected field/value/time/source/return context. Search execution, network/backend work, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: The bounded dialect-neutral PivotDraft runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to local draft preparation; Event Search execution, providers and production SLOs remain outside this target.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process validation and immutable projection of one already-resolved caller-owned Hunt workspace envelope, including tenant/environment scope, question, period, owner/contributors and typed accessible object references. Retrieval, persistence, query execution, provider work, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: The bounded Hunt Management projection runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to deterministic local workspace validation/projection overhead; retrieval, persistence, query execution, providers and production Hunt SLOs remain outside this target.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process validation and immutable projection of one already-resolved caller-owned Saved Search / Query Asset snapshot, including tenant/access scope, stable Query/version identity, parameters, source/field prerequisites, author and validation metadata. Retrieval, persistence, query execution, providers, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: The bounded Saved Query Asset projection runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to deterministic local compatibility projection overhead; retrieval, persistence, provider work and production Saved Search/Event Search SLOs remain outside this target.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process construction of one immutable backend-neutral Event Search execution handoff from a validated Query Asset projection while preserving tenant, Query/version, opaque parameter values and source context. Search Job creation/execution, retrieval, persistence, providers, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: The bounded Saved Query Asset handoff runtime is executable. The 1 ms shared-CI ceiling applies only to local immutable handoff construction; Event Search execution, Search Job work, providers and production SLOs remain outside this target.

targets.workload_description: Future deterministic in-process validation and immutable projection of one already-resolved caller-owned Case Queue input, including tenant/access scope, Case identity/status/owner context, optional Incident/Finding context and explicit freshness/partial diagnostics. Retrieval, persistence, backend search, providers, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: Preimplementation engineering ceiling for pure local Case Queue validation/projection only. It remains on-demand until executable runtime exists and is not a storage, backend search or production queue SLO.

targets.workload_description: Future deterministic in-process application of one already-resolved Shared Saved View snapshot to an immutable Case Queue projection with permission-re-evaluated filters, sort and field visibility. Saved View persistence/share/manage operations, provider work, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: Preimplementation engineering ceiling for pure local Saved View application only. It makes no Shared Saved View persistence or production UI SLO claim.

targets.workload_description: Future deterministic in-process construction of one immutable Case Workspace transition/return-context envelope from an accessible selected Case and already-validated queue state. Navigation transport, backend retrieval, Case mutation, browser paint/layout, build and process-startup time are excluded.
targets.rationale: Preimplementation engineering ceiling for pure local handoff/return-context construction only. It is not a production navigation or Case Workspace SLO.
